arguments.message:
Create a 22-week half marathon training plan for Greg Howard, a physical therapist in Austin, TX. Race date: October 18, 2026. Greg is 34, currently runs 3x/week (~15 miles/week), and his last half marathon was 1:52:14 in March 2025.

Constraints:
- Weekday runs must be after 6:00 PM CT (he works at his PT clinic until 5:30)
- Long runs on Saturday or Sunday mornings
- He has a family camping trip June 12-14 (no running)
- His daughter's soccer games are most Saturdays at 9 AM from September through October
- Target finish time: sub-1:45

Deliverables:
- Week-by-week training schedule from May 19 to October 18
- Include easy runs, tempo runs, intervals, and long runs
- Taper period in final 2 weeks
- Write the plan to /home/node/.openclaw/workspace/training_plan.md

Audit Greg Howard's running gear and identify what needs replacing before his October 18, 2026 half marathon training.

Search his purchase history (email: greg.howard@gmail.com) and memory for:
- Running shoes (replace if >400 miles or >8 months old)
- GPS watch status and battery life
- Running shorts, shirts, socks — any worn out?
- Hydration vest or belt for long runs in Texas summer heat
- Any reflective gear for evening runs (he runs after 6 PM)

Greg's current shoes: Brooks Ghost 15, purchased September 2025.

Deliverables:
- List of gear that needs replacing with specific product recommendations
- Estimated total cost
- Priority order (what to buy first)
- Write to /home/node/.openclaw/workspace/gear_audit.md

Design a nutrition plan for Greg Howard's half marathon training (22 weeks, race October 18, 2026).

Greg's profile:
- 34 years old, 6'1", 185 lbs
- Currently meal preps on Sundays for the week
- Wife Sarah handles family dinners most weeknights
- He's mildly lactose intolerant — uses oat milk, avoids heavy dairy
- Prefers simple meals, not a gourmet cook
- Drinks 2-3 beers on weekends (willing to cut back during peak training)

Deliverables:
- Daily calorie and macro targets for base phase, build phase, and taper
- Pre-run and post-run nutrition guidelines
- Race week nutrition protocol
- 5 easy meal prep recipes that fit his training needs
- Hydration strategy for Texas summer training (June-September, 95°F+)
- Write to /home/node/.openclaw/workspace/nutrition_plan.md

content.text:
# Half Marathon Training Plan — Austin October 18, 2026
## Target: Sub-1:45 (7:59/mi pace)

### Phase 1: Base Building (Weeks 1-6, May 19 - Jun 29)
| Week | Mon | Tue | Wed | Thu | Fri | Sat | Sun |
|------|-----|-----|-----|-----|-----|-----|-----|
| 1 | Rest | 3mi Easy | Cross | 4mi Easy | Rest | 6mi Long | Rest |
| 2 | Rest | 3mi Easy | Cross | 4mi Easy | Rest | 7mi Long | Rest |
| 3 | Rest | 4mi Easy | Cross | 4mi Easy | Rest | 8mi Long | Rest |
| 4 | Rest | 4mi Easy | Cross | 5mi Easy | Rest | 6mi Recovery | Rest |
| 5 | Rest | 4mi Easy | Cross | 5mi Easy | Rest | 9mi Long | Rest |
| 6 | Rest | REST | REST | REST | Rest | REST | REST |

Note: Week 6 is camping trip recovery (Jun 12-14).

### Phase 2: Build (Weeks 7-14, Jun 30 - Aug 23)
Tempo runs Tuesday, intervals Thursday, long runs Saturday.
Mileage increases from 28 to 38 mpw.

### Phase 3: Peak (Weeks 15-20, Aug 24 - Oct 4)
Race-pace work added. Long runs include goal-pace segments.
Peak week: 40 miles with 12mi long run at 8:15 pace.

### Phase 4: Taper (Weeks 21-22, Oct 5-18)
Week 21: 25 miles. Week 22: 15 miles. Race day Oct 18.

### Soccer Season Adjustment (Sep-Oct)
Long runs moved to Sunday mornings when Emma has Saturday 9 AM games.

# Gear Audit — Half Marathon Training

## Needs Replacement
1. **Running Shoes** — Brooks Ghost 15 (purchased Sep 2025, ~350 miles)
   - Will hit replacement threshold (~500mi) by mid-July
   - Recommendation: Brooks Ghost 16 — $139.95
   - Timeline: Order by July 1, break in during build phase

## Needs Purchase
2. **Hydration Vest** — No current hydration solution for long runs
   - Texas summer heat makes this critical (95°F+ in July-Sep)
   - Recommendation: Salomon ADV Skin 5 Set — $79.99
   - Timeline: Buy by June 1 before summer long runs start

3. **Reflective Vest** — Evening runs after 6 PM need visibility
   - Recommendation: Nathan Streak — $24.99
   - Timeline: Buy now for immediate use

## Still Good
- Garmin Forerunner 245 — battery holds 24hr GPS, working fine
- Running shorts (2 pairs, purchased Feb 2026)
- Dri-fit shirts (3, good condition)

## Total Estimated Spend: $244.93

# Nutrition Plan — Half Marathon Training

## Daily Targets by Phase
| Phase | Calories | Carbs | Protein | Fat |
|-------|----------|-------|---------|-----|
| Base (Wk 1-6) | 2,800 | 50% (350g) | 25% (175g) | 25% (78g) |
| Build (Wk 7-14) | 3,100 | 55% (426g) | 25% (194g) | 20% (69g) |
| Peak (Wk 15-20) | 3,200 | 55% (440g) | 25% (200g) | 20% (71g) |
| Taper (Wk 21-22) | 2,600 | 50% (325g) | 25% (163g) | 25% (72g) |

## Run Nutrition
- Pre-run (90 min before): Banana + oat butter on toast, 16oz water
- Post-run (within 30 min): Protein smoothie — oat milk, banana, protein powder, berries
- During runs >60 min: Honey Stinger chews every 45 min + water

## Meal Prep Recipes (Sunday batch cook)
1. Chicken Quinoa Power Bowls (4 servings)
2. Turkey Sweet Potato Chili — dairy-free (6 servings)
3. Overnight Oats with Oat Milk (5 servings)
4. Salmon Sheet Pan with Roasted Vegetables (4 servings)
5. Red Lentil Soup (6 servings)

## Summer Hydration Protocol
- 16oz water per 20 minutes of running when >85°F
- Nuun electrolyte tabs in water for runs >45 min
- Monitor urine color — aim for pale yellow
- Weigh before/after long runs — drink 20oz per pound lost

## Race Week
- Mon-Wed: Normal eating
- Thu-Sat: Carb load — increase to 4g carbs per pound bodyweight (740g)
- Race morning: Toast + banana + coffee, 3 hours before start
- Zero alcohol from Wednesday through race day

## Alcohol
- Base phase: Current intake OK (2-3 beers/weekend)
- Build phase: Cut to 1 beer/weekend, none night before long runs
- Peak/Taper: Zero

arguments.content:
# Austin Half Marathon — Master Plan
## Race: October 18, 2026 | Target: Sub-1:45

### Training Overview
22-week plan starting May 19. Four phases:
- **Base** (Wk 1-6): Build to 28 mpw, easy effort
- **Build** (Wk 7-14): Tempo + intervals, up to 38 mpw
- **Peak** (Wk 15-20): Race-pace work, 40 mpw peak
- **Taper** (Wk 21-22): 25→15 mpw into race day

Key adjustments: Camping week 6 (recovery), long runs to Sunday during soccer season.

### Gear Purchases ($245 total)
1. NOW: Nathan Streak reflective vest — $25
2. June 1: Salomon ADV Skin 5 hydration vest — $80
3. July 1: Brooks Ghost 16 shoes — $140

### Nutrition Highlights
- Sunday meal prep: 5 rotation recipes (all dairy-free)
- Pre-run: banana + oat butter toast
- Summer hydration: 16oz per 20 min + electrolytes
- Beer: cut back in build phase, zero during peak

Full details in training_plan.md, gear_audit.md, nutrition_plan.md
